To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ATP, acting via cAMP-dependent protein phosphorylation, enhances Ca2+-dependent insulin exocytotic events in beta cells.
ATP is an important post-primering factor in insulin exocytotic process in beta cells.
ATP acts as a post-priming regulator of Ca2+-dependent insulin exocytotic process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms of insulin exocytic secretion in pancreatic beta cells and the possible involvement of cytosolic nucleotides, such as ATP, in the regulation of insulin exocysis.
the role of cytosol ATP as a sensor in the exocytotic process in beta cells.
the mechanisms by which ATP and Ca2+ act in concert to control the exocytotic release of insulin from pancreatic beta cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ATP-dependent exocytosis is a two-step process: ATP-dependent priming and Ca2+-dependent triggering.
ATP acts as an important modulator of insulin secretion by regulating both the exocytotic and the ATP-sensitive K+ channel pathways.
, in the pancreatic beta cell, ATP acts at two levels: (i) as a sensor for glucose metabolism and insulin release and (ii) as a post-primering regulator of exocytosis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

there are at least two different types of ATP sensors for insulin exocytic machinery, one of which is the ATP-sensitive K+ channel, and the other is the ATP sensor that is involved in the exocytic machinery.
ATP acts on exocytosis through at least two distinct mechanisms.
ATP is an essential molecule in the process of exocytosis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ATP is a post-priming regulator of exocytosis.
ATP can regulate exocytosis at two levels: the ATP-sensitive K(+) channel and the Ca(2+)-dependent exocytotic apparatus.
the ATP sensing system is not only involved in the priming process of exocytosis but is also involved in the triggering step of exocytotic release.
